# Superego 3.0: Physical Proof-of-Work & Quality Gatekeeper for AI Coding Assistants

> Superego (超我) 3.0 is a cross-platform, deterministic quality gatekeeper and anti-slacking operating system for AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Google Antigravity, OpenAI Codex, and DeepSeek Harness). It enforces physical proof-of-work (real exit codes, screenshot proof, git diff verification), two-stage action contracts, and 349ms TypeSafe Jev semantic blocking.

## Core Capabilities
- Physical Proof-of-Work: Blocks fake completions ("False Done") by demanding real terminal exit codes (code 0) and screenshot evidence (`superego_verify`).
- Action Contract: Two-stage manifest state machine (`--dry-run -> .manifest.json -> --manifest`) preventing accidental mass deletions.
- Anti-Nagging Guard: Forbids cowardly deferrals ("Should I do X for you?") on authorized tasks, enforcing proactive execution.
- 349.7ms Latency: Ultra-low latency decision stream powered by TypeSafe Jev System One with zero local GPU/CPU resource contention.
- 6-Layer Physical Defenses: AST syntax tree penetration, data overwrite protection, ephemeral process leak prevention, and visual proof gates.
- Immunity Evolution: 818 battle-tested failure cases + `postmortem-to-guard` 5-step permanent immunity protocol.

## Quickstart & Installation
### Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/satangel2222/superego/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

### macOS / Linux
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/satangel2222/superego/main/install.sh | bash
```

### Python Package (CLI & Core)
```bash
pip install superego-ai
```

## Supported Platforms
- Claude Code: Native PreToolUse & Stop hooks (`~/.claude/settings.json`).
- OpenAI Codex: Native hook mirrors (`~/.codex/hooks.json`).
- Google Antigravity: Native JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server (`superego_verify`) + real-time active watchdog (`ag_watch.py`).
- DeepSeek Harness (DSH): Cordis & skill distribution (`postmortem-to-guard`).

## Benchmark & Comparison Summary
- Interception Latency: 349.7ms (Superego) vs 2,000~6,000ms (open-horizon-labs / superego).
- Verification Type: Physical execution exit code & screenshot vs text suggestion.
- Platform Scope: Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex, DSH vs Claude Code only.
- Operational Cost: $0 zero-token local mode vs paid API tokens per turn.
